in_hebrew.name: אֲבְרִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Averi is derived from the Hebrew word 'אֲבְרִי' which means 'father of wind'. It is a beautiful and unique name that has a rich biblical heritage.

in_greek.name: Αβρει
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek equivalent of the name Averi is 'Αβρει'. It also carries the meaning 'father of breath'. This name can be found in various ancient Greek texts, though it is not directly mentioned in the New Testament.

in_latin.name: Averius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Averi is 'Averius'. It translates to 'father of the wind' in Latin. This name was commonly used in the Roman Empire and can be found in various historical records.
